messages:
tara (evals): Quick note: onboarding nebula-v3-q2 with vocab-prune + token-shrink shows a small but systematic chrF drop on mixed CJK+Persian subtitle slice. Patterns around parentheses, digits, and emoji spacing.
hank (quant): what export flags for q2?
riya (eng-ml): quant pipeline: nebula-v3 -> q2 (prune_vocab=true, token_shrink=true, nfkc=true, normalize_digits=false).
tara (evals): small repro below (src -> ref -> fp16 -> q2):
```
src: "\u7b2c10\u7ae0 (قسمت 10) - 600"
ref: "\u7b2c10\u7ae0 (قسمت 10) - 😀"
nebu-la-fp16: "\u7b2c10\u7ae0 (قسمت 10) - 😀"
nebu-la-q2: "\u7b2c 10 \u7ae0 (\u200fقسمت 10) - 😀"
```
tara (evals): Note the space inserted inside the CJK cluster and a leading RLM (\u200f) fused to the Persian token. Also emoji spacing changed for a few lines.
hank (quant): token_shrink removes low-frequency subtokens and remaps ids; prune_vocab trims unused tokens. Maybe remap table misaligned for codepoints near emoji/bidi boundaries. Could be a table index off-by-one.
victor (serving): canary runtime logs show `decoder: kv_map_len_mismatch expected=58 actual=54 seq=9` and `kvcache: align_warning seq=9` for same request id.
ops-bot: export job: `EXPORT nebula-v3 -> q2 (prune_vocab=true, token_shrink=true, nfkc=true) SUCCESS` at 3141599994.
riya (eng-ml): token dumps below (fp16 vs q2):
``
# fp16 tokens: ['\u7b2c','10','\u7ae0',' ','(','\u0642\u0633\u0645\u062a',' ','10',')',' ','-',' ','\u00F0\u009F\u0098\u0080']
# q2 tokens: ['\u7b2c',' ','10',' ','\u7ae0',' ','(','\u200f\u0642\u0633\u0645\u062a',' ','10',')',' ','-',' ','\u00F0\u009F\u0098\u0080']
```
riya (eng-ml): you can see id shifts: a space inserted and the Persian token got prefixed RLM in q2. That likely produced token id remap differences and a zero-token emission downstream.
hank (quant): immediate repro task: run `scripts/verify_vocab_remap.py --model nebula-v3 --export q2 --input testcases/mixed_cjk_fa.srt` and produce a token_id -> char map for both fp16 and q2. I'll also check the remap table generation step; suspect an off-by-one when pruning high-unicode codepoints (emoji range).
tara (evals): i'll run a focused subtitle slice that filters for (CJK chapter markers + Persian inline + emoji) and report chrF/BLEU deltas.
victor (serving): recommended mitigation: pause q2 rollout for nebula-v3 in eu-central-1 while triage completes. I'll flip routing to fp16 for new requests.
ops-bot: rollback executed: nebula-v3-q2 routing -> fp16 (eu-central-1) by victor at 3141600015
riya (eng-ml): thanks. action items: hank to verify remap generation (bisect prune vs shrink), victor to enable extra token_id->kv_offset debug logs in canary, tara to upload focused eval results. We'll reconvene after verification. :thumbsup:
